en.headline: 7 own commits plus 13 automated in sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu
en.summary: **7 own commits** were made in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, plus 13 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`. The own work formatted `providers.json`, adjusted `.gitignore` rules for `.history` and `.history/scripts/daily`, and documented error-handling functions in `generate-activity.mjs`. It also refactored `diagnose` so the probe deduplication key includes headers and the probe has a `catch` fallback, then optimized concurrent probing to reduce duplicate requests. In `openchamber/openchamber`, the user opened issue #5584, “[Bug] Quote card's arrow is a silent no-op when the quoted message is outside the loaded history”, which remains open with 1 comment. `openchamber-bot[bot]` replied that the cause was traced and the fix is mostly wiring around `loadHistoryUntilMessage`.

zh.headline: sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu 有 7 次本人提交，另有 13 次自动提交
zh.summary: 在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 完成 **7 次本人提交**，另有 13 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交。本人工作包括格式化 `providers.json`、调整 `.gitignore` 中对 `.history` 与 `.history/scripts/daily` 的忽略规则，以及为 `generate-activity.mjs` 中的错误处理函数补充注释。同时重构了 `diagnose`，让探测去重键包含 headers，并为 probe 增加 `catch` 兜底，还优化了并发探测逻辑以减少重复请求。在 `openchamber/openchamber`，用户新开了 issue #5584“[Bug] Quote card's arrow is a silent no-op when the quoted message is outside the loaded history”，该 issue 仍为开放状态，共有 1 条评论。`openchamber-bot[bot]` 回复称原因已定位，修复主要是围绕 `loadHistoryUntilMessage` 的接线工作。
